Name: Everyday essentials
Description: Browse, chat, watch videos, open PDFs, protect passwords and find or share your files.

Name: Work & documents
Description: Documents, email, PDFs and scanning, diagrams, tasks, clipboard history and cloud files for a complete working day.

Name: Study & research
Description: Notes, references and citations, PDF reading, handwritten annotations, ebooks, assignments and file sync.

Name: Open-source essentials
Description: A complete open-source desktop for browsing, documents, notes, media, passwords, messaging, screenshots and file sync.

Name: Video editing
Description: Edit and colour video, trim without re-encoding, convert exports, record screens, clean audio and prepare graphics. Configure project backup after installation.

Name: Design & interfaces
Description: Raster and vector graphics, interface prototypes, image previews, screenshots, asset transfer and project backup. Figma needs an account.

Name: Audio production
Description: Record and mix in REAPER, edit waveforms in Audacity, write scores, capture sessions and organize notes and project files. REAPER requires a license after evaluation.

Name: 3D & printing
Description: 3D modelling, CAD, print slicing, vector references, image previews and project files. Check slicer compatibility with your printer.

Name: Streaming & capture
Description: Broadcast with OBS, manage Twitch chat, talk with your community, capture images, edit audio and prepare video clips.

Name: Files & backup
Description: Find files and disk space, compare folders, copy reliably, synchronize backups and share between devices. Configure a backup destination and schedule.

Name: Privacy & security
Description: Passwords and two-factor codes, encrypted messaging, encrypted folders and drives, plus device-to-device file sync. Configure accounts and recovery keys.

Name: Gaming
Description: Steam and Epic libraries together in Playnite, voice chat, screenshots and recording, archive tools, hardware monitoring and account protection.

Name: Software development
Description: Editor, Git and its desktop client, Python and Node.js, terminal, API testing, containers and database tools. Docker licensing depends on your organization.

Name: PC essentials
Description: File search, disk space and health, hardware information, startup and process inspection, useful Windows controls and screenshots.

Name: Remote work
Description: Documents, team calls, email, tasks, cloud files, screenshots and secure accounts. Teams and OneDrive need your organization or personal account.

Name: Illustration & digital art
Description: Paint in Krita, build vectors, prepare raster assets, preview references and keep project files organized across devices.

Name: Photography & RAW
Description: Develop RAW photos, browse and retouch images, rename batches, convert files and synchronize a photo backup.

Name: Home media & reading
Description: Organize films, music and ebooks, convert video for your devices, view pictures and transfer or synchronize your media files.

Name: Web development
Description: Build websites with Node.js and pnpm, test APIs and browsers, work with containers and databases, and version your code.

Name: Game development
Description: Create games in Godot with 3D assets, painted textures and edited audio, then version, record and share your work.
